name: Race of Life
source:
[b][i]Race of Life[/i][/b] is a college/street racing Adult Visual Novel. You play [b]Jake Miller[/b], a divorced Professor who has taken up teaching after his past mistakes cost him his lucrative job and his marriage. 

Jake is smart, attractive, and not shy about using those attributes to get what he wants - which almost always involves fast cars or fast women.

The only thing Jake loves more than spending time working on his car with his best friend Cooper, a mechanic with his own garage is meeting new women for a good time, not a long time. Recently, he’s started a casual dating relationship with another teacher, but is it just so she can help him with his research grants or is he starting to get tired of all the random hookups?

Most important of all to Jake is his six-year-old daughter Lily. Jake loves spending time with her, as long as his vicious and possessive ex-wife Allison isn’t trying to make his life harder.

When tragedy strikes, Jake must use every ounce of skill, smarts and ruthlessness to keep his life together and become the man he always wanted to be. 

[b]Life in the underground racing scene is all about suck, squeeze, bang, blow. The more rubber you burn the more money you earn.[/b]

[From [url=https://raceoflifegame.com]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
[b][i]Race of Life[/i][/b] 是一部大学/街头赛车成人视觉小说。你扮演[b]杰克·米勒[/b]，一位离婚的教授，在过去的错误导致他失去了丰厚的工作和婚姻后，他开始从事教学工作。

杰克聪明、有吸引力，而且毫不羞于利用这些特质来得到他想要的东西——这几乎总是涉及快车或快女人。

除了与他最好的朋友库珀（一位拥有自己的车库的机械师）一起修车之外，杰克唯一喜欢的就是结识新女人，度过一段美好的时光，而不是很长时间。最近，他与另一位老师开始了随意的约会关系，但这只是为了她可以帮助他获得研究资助，还是他开始厌倦所有随机的勾搭？

对杰克来说最重要的是他六岁的女儿莉莉。杰克喜欢和她在一起，只要他恶毒且占有欲强的前妻艾莉森不试图让他的生活变得更加困难。

当悲剧发生时，杰克必须运用一切技巧、智慧和冷酷来维持自己的生活，并成为他一直想成为的人。

[b]地下赛车现场的生活就是吸、挤、撞、吹。你燃烧的橡胶越多，你赚的钱就越多。[/b]

[来自[url=https://raceoflifegame.com]官方网站[/url]]
